description.value: Stacked Pancake & Breakfast House is a proudly Canadian breakfast chain founded in 2016 and now operating over 100 locations nationwide. The Pitt Meadows outpost serves a broad menu of pancake stacks, eggs benedict, waffles, omelettes, and lunch burgers, with vegetarian and gluten-friendly options throughout. Situated in a Lougheed Highway plaza, it is a convenient stop for cyclists touring the Pitt Meadows and Maple Ridge corridor.

address.value: 19800 Lougheed Highway Unit 361, Pitt Meadows, BC V3Y 2W1
